description: Process note, no escalation tier: the operator's rulings on the register after the Phase 23 code-review fix run, and how they were applied. The fix run (fixers A, B and C; merged at f6f6589, 8e9b0e4 and f9eedef) made many triage tests stricter. Fixer A's WR-01 work made the simulated chain enforce reverts as a real one does (a swap past its deadline is refused by the relay's eth_callBundle and by eth_estimateGas, and mines with status 0); with that on, AUD-TX-003 failed and AUD-TX-029 read looks fixed, because both private escalations reached attempts after their swap's 60 s deadline. Fixer A stopped the line on it, and the operator ruled that realistic reverts become the default and both findings are re-triaged on the realistic chain (780d67d, 354e2fc, eb34470). On 2026-11-12 the operator ruled on the register changes below. The execute-phase orchestrator relayed the rulings to the register executor in its own words; the operator's own words were not relayed, so none are quoted here and none are invented. As relayed, no severity or status changes unless stated: (1) AUD-TX-003 (S1, confirmed): correct the about 4 minutes / 4 attempts wording to the realistic measurement (the snipe holds the lock about 105 s: 2 bundles, then the third simulation is refused as EXPIRED; the anti-rug exit dispatched 8.0 s in still gives up at exactly 60 000 ms; the abandoned exit first sends at dispatch + 96.6 s); the claim is unchanged. (2) AUD-TX-029 (S3, confirmed): retire claim attempt-budget-reported-as-ceiling-hit; the proven claim is sell-attempt-budget-reported-as-ceiling-hit; retitle for two-attempt legs (routine sell, deliberate buy). (3) AUD-EXIT-014: the recommendation says a fix must outlast or pre-empt an in-flight exit that holds the nonce lock (about 76 s measured, longer than the 60 s anti-rug watchdog) and cross-references AUD-ANTIRUG-003 for the breaker tripping on one pull. (4) AUD-EXIT-007: add the V3 anti-rug path evidence (the watchdog fires first, broadcasts success false and alerts that the position is still held + monitored, which is false on that path; the sell keeps running and later strands the position with no poll timer). (5) AUD-EXIT-002: register claim first-quote-transient-failure-leaves-position-unmonitored beside the base claim. (6) AUD-BUY-005: the V2 listener call moves to proven (claim v2-listener-unhandled-rejection-exits). (7) Register the new claims of AUD-EXIT-007 (emergency-sell-v3-not-landed-leaves-no-poll, antirug-v3-not-landed-leaves-no-poll), AUD-EXIT-008 (operator-emergency-sell-refused-while-routine-paused) and AUD-BUY-027 (non-native-v3-pool-processed). (8) Register a new finding, S2, confirmed, fix Phase 29: a snipe's private escalation outlives its own 60 s swap deadline (AUD-BUY-039). Applied with set-triage.ts for every triage block (outcomes unchanged, so each block was merged) and with the toJson layout and writeAtomic for the other fields. The same pass refreshed five triage notes whose fix-shape sentence the stricter tests had made false (AUD-EXIT-001, AUD-TX-002, AUD-BUY-025, AUD-EXIT-009, AUD-ANTIRUG-002); that is executor bookkeeping, not a ruling. No review or escalation record was written: AC-18 already holds for AUD-TX-003 (TRIAGE-REVIEW-01), AUD-BUY-039 is S2 (no escalation tier) and outside the frozen population, and a review record carries the operator's verbatim words, which were not relayed.
